name: rhize-devflow
description: Rhize Media's development-workflow skill set: compounding persistence layer (verifier subagent, STATE.md contract, protected-file gate), production error lifecycle (Sentry + Vercel), data-mutation consistency across Next.js/Sanity/Payload/Supabase, Sentry instrumentation conventions, Chrome DevTools browser debugging, Sanity house style, and dev-flow foundations.

interface.shortDescription: Mutation consistency, browser debugging, Sentry instrumentation, and Sanity house style for Rhize engineering.
interface.longDescription: Rhize Media's engineering workflow plugin for Next.js/Sanity/Payload/Supabase projects deployed on Vercel: mutation-consistency analysis that catches cache tags drifting from frontend query keys, Chrome DevTools-backed browser debugging and performance tracing, Rhize's in-code Sentry instrumentation conventions, Sanity house style for schemas and GROQ, and the per-repo local tenant-file setup convention. This is the foundation Rhize is building into a full impact-map -> check -> review -> release engineering control plane.
defaultPrompt: Check this mutation for cache/query-key consistency: <file>
Debug console and network errors on <url> with Chrome DevTools.
Set up the local tenant-file convention for this repo.
